_comment: VoxyTube - single-container Egg with Rust service and embedded PostgreSQL
name: VoxyTube
author: Kua <https://github.com/KuaFeur>
description: YouTube WebSub notification gateway. Rust and PostgreSQL are bundled in one container.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The container image already contains the Rust binary and PostgreSQL.
# No additional installation is required.
exit 0

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Internal HTTP port. Allocate this port in Pelican and expose it through HTTPS.

variables.name: PostgreSQL Database Password
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty to generate and persist a random local password automatically.
